form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Read the second time and placed on the calendar

form.official-title: To reauthorize mandatory funding programs for historically Black colleges and universities and other minority-serving institutions.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Fostering Undergraduate Talent by Unlocking Resources for Education Act or the FUTURE Act.

section.header: Strengthening historically black colleges and universities and other minority-serving institutions
section.text: Section 371(b)(1)(A) of the Higher Education Act of 1965 (20 U.S.C. 1067q(b)(1)(A)) is amended—

paragraph.text: in the first sentence, by striking through 2019 and inserting through 2021; and
in the second sentence, by striking 2019 and inserting 2021.

subsection.text: Section 458 of the Higher Education Act of 1965 (20 U.S.C. 1087h) is amended—

subparagraph.text: by redesignating paragraphs (3), (6), (7), and (8) as paragraphs (1), (2), (3), and (4), respectively;

subsection.text: Section 422B(c) of the Higher Education Act of 1965 (20 U.S.C. 1072b(c)) is amended—

paragraph.text: by redesignating paragraphs (4) through (6) as paragraphs (3) through (5), respectively.

subsection.text: The amendments made by this section shall take effect on October 1, 2019.

section.header: Transfer of Federal Pell Grant Funds
section.text: Section 401(b)(7)(A)(iv) of the Higher Education Act of 1965 (20 U.S.C. 1070a(b)(7)(A)(iv)) is amended by striking subclauses (X) and (XI) and inserting the following:

subclause.text: $1,145,000,000 for fiscal year 2026 and each succeeding fiscal year.

section.text: The budgetary effects of this Act, for the purpose of complying with the Statutory Pay-As-You-Go Act of 2010, shall be determined by reference to the latest statement titled Budgetary Effects of PAYGO Legislation for this Act, submitted for printing in the Congressional Record by the Chairman of the Committee on the Budget of the House of Representatives, provided that such statement has been submitted prior to the vote on passage.

attestation-group.attestation-date: Passed the House of Representatives September 17, 2019.

endorsement.action-desc: Read the second time and placed on the calendar
